matched EXACTLY against the scrobbles store — never the substring match
The lists are lists on purpose: Last.fm files a single under its own album name, so
`The Good Witch` and `Lost The Breakup` are separate rows for one campaign. Listing
both folds them into one side without any code change.
`archived: true` means the race is resolved. It stays queryable and the notifier
